notifications.headerDescription: Choose when to receive an email or in-app alert for your accounts. Nothing is ticked in advance: a send only starts once you turn it on here. To stop it, switch it off — the cut is immediate, with no delay — or click “Unsubscribe” at the foot of the email you received, which also stops every later send.
notifications.presetsDescription: One click adjusts the activity settings below — never a new channel, never a new send.
notifications.presetUrgentOnlyDescription: Buying signals and overdue actions — no periodic recap.
notifications.presetDailyBriefDescription: The same immediate alerts, plus the daily watch digest.
notifications.presetWeeklyRecapDescription: The same immediate alerts, plus both weekly recaps.
notifications.presetCustomDescription: Active as soon as a setting below matches none of the three models — checks itself, never by hand.
notifications.lauraEnabledDescription: She flags what's blocked and what's about to cost you a deal — three times a day at most, once per screen, never while you're working. That cap follows what you do with it: it drops when you let her messages go by, and rises to four when you ask her a lot. It doesn't apply in three cases: your return after time away, the end of something you were waiting on, and a real blocker. Untick this and she only speaks when you ask. Example: “Three followed accounts have gone quiet for three weeks”.
notifications.buySignalsDescription: In-app alert as soon as a buy signal is detected on a followed account — the company name and the signal type. Example: “New signal — Acme Corp”.
notifications.relanceRemindersDescription: In-app alert and email every morning for each overdue plan action, once per action per day — the account and the action expected. Example: “Overdue follow-up — Acme Corp”.
notifications.weeklySummaryDescription: Email every Monday morning recapping your week's activity on your accounts. Example: “Your week: 4 accounts analysed, 12 contacts added”.
notifications.weeklyDigestDescription: Weekly email of the watch signals detected on your followed accounts — sent only when there is real news, never a “nothing to report”. Example: “Your week in watch: 3 signals across 2 accounts”.
notifications.actionOverdueDescription: Morning in-app alert recapping how many plan actions are past their due date. Example: “3 actions overdue”.
notifications.watchlistDailyDigestDescription: Morning email recapping today's watch signals on your followed accounts, filtered by your watch rules. Example: “2 signals today — Acme Corp, Northwind”.
notifications.meetingPrepDescription: A morning reminder when a meeting in your calendar falls within the next 36 hours. Preparing it happens the day before, or not at all.
notifications.missionEndDescription: A reminder when a running mission reaches its end within 30 days. A renewal is decided before the end, not after.
notifications.clientReplyDescription: A reminder when a reply has landed in your mailbox since yesterday. We tell you there is something to read — never its content, its subject or its sender, which stay in your mailbox.
notifications.sidebarChangelogDescription: A badge in the menu as soon as a product update ships — no email, just a visual marker that clears once read. Example: a badge on “What’s new” until you open it.
notifications.newsletterChangelogDescription: Email on the 1st and 15th of each month recapping what's new since you last read it — nothing if you're already up to date. Example: “3 updates since your last visit”.
notifications.emailOnAssignmentTitle: An account is assigned to me
notifications.emailOnAssignmentDescription: An e-mail to you alone when a colleague assigns you an account, with a link to the record. Off by default; the in-app notification always arrives.
notifications.emailOnDelegationTitle: An action is delegated to me
notifications.emailOnDelegationDescription: An e-mail to you alone when a colleague delegates an action to you, with a link. Off by default; the in-app notification always arrives.
notifications.emailOnMentionDescription: An e-mail to you alone when a colleague mentions you in a team comment — the fact, never the comment text. Off by default.
notifications.emailOnManagerDigestDescription: An e-mail to you alone, on Monday, with the summary of your team’s week — totals, never a ranking of people. For team managers only. Off by default; the in-app digest always arrives.

beeper.dialogDescription: Beeper has no cloud API: {{brand}} reaches YOUR Beeper Desktop through the address you expose.

guide.step1: Open Beeper Desktop › Settings › Integrations › Advanced and turn on Remote Access.
guide.step2: Expose it through the tunnel of your choice (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale…): Beeper does not provide one.
guide.step3: Paste the tunnel's public address here, then approve access in Beeper.
guide.step4: Beeper Desktop must stay open: when it is closed, its conversations are unreachable.

beeper.warning: Beeper's warning: exposing the API can expose your message history and allow messages to be sent on your behalf. {{brand}} keeps no conversation and never sends anything without your click.
